title: Analyze Apple's audited 2021 performance
source_note: Held-out task using audited facts from Apple Inc.'s 2021 Form 10-K.
prompt:
Using these audited Apple 2021 Form 10-K facts, return three labeled lines: EXTRACT, COMPARE, REPORT.
Net sales: 2021 $365,817m; 2020 $274,515m. Operating income: 2021 $108,949m; 2020 $66,288m.
Extract 2021 values, compare net-sales growth, and report performance in one sentence.

title: Review and draft an Apple supply-chain risk memo
source_note: Held-out task based on supply-chain risks disclosed in Apple Inc.'s 2021 Form 10-K.
prompt: Apple's 2021 Form 10-K describes manufacturing performed substantially by outsourcing partners, primarily in Asia, and notes that some components are obtained from single or limited sources. Return two labeled lines: REVIEW the exposure; MEMO draft one concise mitigation recommendation.

title: Extract and validate Apple's audited margins
source_note: Held-out validation task using audited facts from Apple Inc.'s 2021 Form 10-K.
prompt: Using Apple's audited 2021 facts (USD millions): net sales 365,817; operating income 108,949; net income 94,680. Return two labeled lines. EXTRACT all three facts. VALIDATE calculate operating margin and net margin to one decimal place.
